title: Transpose a Matrix
prompt:
Write the transpose A^T of:

    [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]

The transpose swaps rows and columns, giving a 3×2 matrix.
hint: rows separated by ';', elements by spaces or commas, e.g. 1 4; 2 5; 3 6
recap: The transpose Aᵀ reflects a matrix across its diagonal: entry (i, j) ↦ (j, i), turning m×n into n×m. (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ.
